alert_log: Checkout p99 3.8s; redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections
root_cause: The payment API's connection pool was capped below peak checkout concurrency.
resolution_steps: Raised Redis max_connections from 50 to 200 and set the payments pool limit to 120.

alert_log: Login p95 4.2s; RedisTimeoutError on GET session:<id> after primary failover
root_cause: Auth workers kept using the old Redis primary address after failover.
resolution_steps: Reduced DNS cache TTL from 300s to 15s and restarted all 12 auth workers.

alert_log: Consumer lag reached 1.2M; CommitFailedError: Offset commit cannot be completed
root_cause: Synchronous enrichment kept the consumer from polling within max.poll.interval.ms.
resolution_steps: Raised max.poll.interval.ms from 300000 to 900000 and moved enrichment to 8 workers.

alert_log: Checkout 500s; deadlock detected while updating payment_attempt and invoice
root_cause: Two transaction paths acquired payment_attempt and invoice locks in opposite order.
resolution_steps: Standardized lock order and reduced the transaction timeout from 30s to 8s.

alert_log: Pod terminated; Last State: OOMKilled, exit code 137; RSS peaked at 3.9Gi
root_cause: An unbounded in-memory product cache retained large payloads.
resolution_steps: Capped the cache at 20,000 entries and raised the container memory limit from 2Gi to 4Gi.

alert_log: Redis CPU 100%; commandstats showed 42 KEYS calls/s and request timeouts
root_cause: A scheduled cleanup ran KEYS * against the production keyspace during peak traffic.
resolution_steps: Replaced KEYS with SCAN using COUNT 500 and limited cleanup to 2 batches/s.

alert_log: Group rebalance every 45s; heartbeat session timed out while processing batches
root_cause: The batch-size increase made email processing exceed the consumer session timeout.
resolution_steps: Reduced max.poll.records from 1000 to 200 and set the email worker pool to 16 threads.

alert_log: Readiness probe failed with connection refused; rollout stalled at 40%
root_cause: Synchronous schema checks extended startup to 95s, but no startup probe was configured.
resolution_steps: Added a startup probe with failureThreshold 30 and periodSeconds 5; timeout set to 150s.

alert_log: SQLSTATE 40001: could not serialize access due to concurrent update; 31% jobs failed
root_cause: 12 workers updated the same monthly ledger rows under serializable isolation.
resolution_steps: Partitioned jobs by account across 24 queues and retried SQLSTATE 40001 up to 5 times with jitter.

alert_log: 401 responses rose to 27%; JWT signature verification failed after key rotation
root_cause: The verifier's JWKS cache retained the previous signing key for 10 minutes.
resolution_steps: Reduced JWKS cache TTL from 600s to 30s and enabled refresh on unknown kid.

alert_log: Duplicate stock decrements; offset 883104 replayed after worker restart
root_cause: The consumer committed offsets before the inventory database transaction committed.
resolution_steps: Moved offset commits after DB commit, created a unique event_id index, and capped worker retries at 5 attempts.

alert_log: New pods in ImagePullBackOff for registry.internal/uploads:2026.09.15
root_cause: The deployment referenced an image tag before its registry upload had completed.
resolution_steps: Pinned the deployment to digest sha256:7f31a9c2 and added a 120s image-publish gate.

alert_log: Checkout errors; OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory
root_cause: Payment quote cache keys had no TTL and Redis used the no-eviction policy.
resolution_steps: Set quote-key TTL to 900s and changed Redis maxmemory-policy to allkeys-lru.

alert_log: DB CPU 94%; report_events queries scanned 86M rows for tenant/date filters
root_cause: A migration dropped the composite index on tenant_id and created_at.
resolution_steps: Recreated idx_report_events_tenant_created concurrently and set statement_timeout to 20s.

alert_log: RedisTimeoutError on GET payment:quote:<id>; checkout p99 reached 5.1s
root_cause: A failover left 80 payment API workers connected to the retired Redis primary.
resolution_steps: Reduced Redis DNS cache TTL from 120s to 10s and restarted the 80 stale workers.

    return redis.get(key)
redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: max number of clients reached
root_cause: A rollout doubled checkout concurrency while the Redis client pool remained capped at 40 connections.
resolution_steps: Raised the pool cap to 160, bounded per-request fanout, and verified active clients returned below 70% capacity.

alert_log:

    client.pipeline().execute()
redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: max number of clients reached
root_cause: A new indexer worker count exceeded the shared Redis connection budget due to one unbounded pool per worker.
resolution_steps: Set a 12-connection pool per worker, reduced replica count during catch-up, and established a shared client budget.

    return redis.get(session_key)
redis.exceptions.TimeoutError: Read timed out after 1.0s; endpoint=redis-0.internal

resolution_steps: Flushed resolver caches, recycled workers, reduced application DNS TTL to 10s, and confirmed connections targeted the new primary.

kafka.errors.CommitFailedError: group has already rebalanced

2026-11-07T01:39:12Z ERROR migrations: waiting for schema lock (elapsed=88s)
Warning Unhealthy: Startup probe failed 15 times
root_cause: The service performs a slow schema warmup, but the startup probe budget was shorter than normal cold start time.
resolution_steps: Added a startup probe allowing 180 seconds, kept readiness strict, and staggered deployment replicas.

psycopg.errors.SerializationFailure: could not serialize access due to concurrent update

resolution_steps: Partitioned work by merchant, added bounded retries with exponential jitter, and tracked serialization failures by queue.

  UPDATE reservation SET state='confirmed' WHERE id=$1

psycopg.errors.QueryCanceled: statement timeout

resolution_steps: Created index concurrently on (tenant_id, user_id), analyzed the table, and rolled back the unbounded query plan.

psycopg.errors.DeadlockDetected: deadlock detected

redis.exceptions.ResponseError: OOM command not allowed
root_cause: Search result keys were written without expiration while Redis was configured with noeviction.
resolution_steps: Added a 20-minute TTL to result keys, enabled allkeys-lru, and reclaimed old unbounded keys in controlled batches.

resolution_steps: Forced JWKS refresh across instances, reduced cache TTL to 30 seconds, and added refresh-on-signature-failure with rate limiting.
